Class AbstractCrossTableBatchGetBuilder<S extends AbstractCrossTableBatchGetBuilder<S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractCrossTableBatchGetBuilder<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncCrossTableBatchGetBuilder, CrossTableBatchGetBuilder
public abstract class AbstractCrossTableBatchGetBuilder<S extends AbstractCrossTableBatchGetBuilder<S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async cross-table batch get builders.

Manages entries (key + table associations), consistent read, projection, and consumed capacity settings shared across sync and async variants.

    • project

      public @NonNull S project(@NonNull String... attributes)
      Restricts the returned attributes for the most recently added entry to the specified attribute names.

      Projection is applied server-side, reducing data transfer and consumed capacity.

      Parameters:
      attributes - the attribute names to include
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no entries have been added yet
